original_benchmark.notes: 461 tasks from 51 ICLR/NeurIPS 2024 papers. 36 tasks fail upstream's own masking step (listed source file absent from the repository, or README.md listed as a source) and are skipped by the upstream harness as invalid_task. For 4 more, the setup-judge prompt exceeds the o3-mini judge's 200k-token context even without an agent patch, so upstream's judge cannot grade them.
